messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy paused: release 2024.12.3 failed post-deploy checks for service model-gateway, reason: TLS SAN mismatch between staging and prod certificates. See /ci/logs/2024.12.3/healthcheck.

maria: saw the alert, grabbing certs now.

kai: which clusters? staging or prod?

maria: staging cluster: rw-staging-02, prod: rw-prod-01. healthchecks failing on prod canary with 502/handshake errors.

sam: running a quick check:
```
openssl s_client -connect model-gateway.rw-prod-01:443 -servername model-gateway.rw-prod-01 
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
...
subject=/CN=model-gateway.redwood.ai
subjectAltName=DNS:model-gateway.redwood.ai
```
Note: SAN doesn't include the internal svc name we use in staging.

irene: that's the parity issue — staging & canaries talk to the service using internal DNS name model-gateway.internal.svc, prod uses model-gateway.redwood.ai, cert only covers the latter. readiness probe in new image hits internal name and fails TLS check.

release-manager: Is this caused by our new readiness probe change in 2024.12.3? I remember we tightened hostname validation.

maria: yes, readiness now enforces servername in TLS. previous image accepted the cert despite hostname mismatch. new image is stricter.

kai: options: 1) reissue cert to include internal.svc (not great mid-release), 2) change probe to use prod name (risky), 3) rollback to previous image until we fix certs.

sam: logs from deploy controller:
```
2024-06-03T16:12:02Z deploy-controller: canary model-gateway-2024.12.3 failing readiness: tls: certificate is valid for model-gateway.redwood.ai, not model-gateway.internal.svc
2024-06-03T16:12:05Z deploybot: promoted 0/3 pods
```

irene: reissuing cert requires change window and KMS rotation; that'll take a day. not feasible for this release.

release-manager: we need a decision fast. rolling forward will keep customer traffic down. rollback keeps prod stable.

maria: propose rollback to image registry.redwood/release/model-gateway:2024.12.2 and create a postmortem + env-parity ticket to align cert SANs.

kai: +1 from infra side. I'll trigger rollback. deploying in 2m and monitoring.

sam: add a note to the release notes: "Rollback due to TLS hostname validation; fix scheduled for 2024-06-04 change window."

maria: I'll open the parity ticket: AUTH-2982 "cert SAN mismatch: internal vs external hostnames" and link to this thread and logs.

release-manager: also update the deploy checklist to include cert SAN parity test between clusters.

deploy-bot: Action: rollback initiated for service model-gateway -> image registry.redwood/release/model-gateway:2024.12.2. Release 2024.12.3 paused.

kai: rollback completed, canaries healthy again. prod at nominal. ETA to close thread: 10m.

deploy-bot: Release paused by automated checks has been resolved via rollback. Next steps: maria to open AUTH-2982, infra to schedule cert rotation plan, and release-manager to decide if 2024.12.3 should be held for next deploy window.

maria: created AUTH-2982 and assigned to @kai and @irene, added logs and openssl dumps.

release-manager: holding 2024.12.3 until parity fix is implemented. Will add a note to the release calendar. :calendar:

sam: small follow-up — let's add a quick synthetic that validates cert SANs for internal probes during preflight. I'll add to CI.

irene: agree. we should also audit other services for similar naming mismatches.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by users.
